title: New Orleans Ghost Tour in 6 Languages (Self-Guided Audio Tour)
includes: Audio tracks for each tour stop
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Discover the spooky side of New Orleans at your own pace with this self-guided audio tour. Using just your phone, delve into the city’s haunted history filled with chilling tales and ghostly sound effects. Available in six languages—English, Spanish, Portuguese, Hindi, Chinese, and Japanese—this tour offers a unique way to experience the eerie vibes of the French Quarter and beyond. No app or login is needed, making it easy to explore whenever you want.

- Experience New Orleans’ haunted history through an audio tour
- Enjoy chilling stories complemented by eerie music and stories
- Available in English, Spanish, Portuguese, Hindi, Chinese, and Japanese
- Easy access—just use your phone and headphones, no app or login required
